verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs describe AI reviews that suggest fixes, which you can apply in one click from the review page. An Agent launched from the PR page makes direct code changes that are committed to the branch and appear in the PR like any other commit. Agents can also generate changes and open a draft PR as a follow-up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that review findings convert reliably into committed fixes in practice.
